tools.name: remove_custom_claim
tools.description: Removes a custom claim.

tools.name: create_configuration
tools.description: Creates another configuration in the tenant from the starter content (a demo user and a demo client), with a name unique in the tenant and a profile. Prefer a separate client per environment in one configuration; create a configuration for a different profile or a separate set of users. A retry with

tools.name: remove_user
tools.description: Removes a user (at least one must remain).

tools.name: edit_settings
tools.description: Edits the settings; fields left out keep their value. settings: { profile?, b2c_policy_claim? (tfp or acr), validate_client_secrets?, token_lifetime_minutes?, token_shape?: { scope_claim_name?, scope_claim_format?, roles_claim_name?, roles_nested_key?, access_token_audience? } }.

tools.name: get_configuration
tools.description: Returns one configuration of the tenant as items: clients, users, custom and standard claims, settings and endpoints.

tools.name: request_claim_code
tools.description: Issues a single-use claim code for an unclaimed tenant. It works for 15 minutes and replaces any earlier code. Show the code and claim_page_url to the user; never store the code.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Describes the profiles (claims, URL shapes, protocol behaviors), token shape options, standard claims, limits, the current terms version and the rules agents must follow. Read it before configuring a tenant.

tools.name: remove_client
tools.description: Removes a client.

tools.name: create_tenant
tools.description: Creates an unverified HeyIdentity test tenant with a working demo client and test user, accepting the current Terms of Use on behalf of the operator running the agent. Returns endpoints, an agent token, the fixed claim page URL, the expiry time and next_steps.

tools.name: edit_user
tools.description: Edits a user; fields left out keep their value, and claims, when given, replace the user's claims.

tools.name: add_client
tools.description: Adds a client. client: { client_id, client_secret?, allow_all_return_urls?, redirect_uris?, allowed_scopes?, exposed_scopes?, access_token_audience? }.

tools.name: edit_client
tools.description: Edits a client; fields left out keep their value. changes: { client_secret?, allow_all_return_urls?, redirect_uris?, allowed_scopes?, exposed_scopes?, access_token_audience? }.

tools.name: validate_configuration
tools.description: Reports problems (e.g. a client without a redirect URI) and warnings (e.g. a scope no client requests) without changing anything.

tools.name: add_custom_claim
tools.description: Adds a custom claim emitted for every user. claim: { name, value, target?: both|id_token|access_token }.

tools.name: edit_custom_claim
tools.description: Edits a custom claim's value or target; fields left out keep their value. changes: { value?, target? }.

tools.name: set_standard_claims
tools.description: Sets which of the profile's generated standard claims are enabled (see get_configuration's standard_claims.available).

tools.name: get_tenant
tools.description: Returns the tenant, its configurations and their endpoints, its limits and status.

tools.name: rotate_signing_key
tools.description: Generates a new RSA signing key for this configuration. overlap=true keeps the previous key published for the configured window; false removes every earlier key immediately. Needs Pro or Enterprise (or Vetted assurance); rate limited per configuration. Returns the current kid and published keys.

tools.name: list_signing_keys
tools.description: Lists a configuration's published key IDs, status, source and expiry. Available on every plan; returns no key material.

tools.name: add_user
tools.description: Adds a fictional test user. user: { key, display_name?, sub?, icon?, access_token_sub?, claims?: { name: string|number|boolean|string[] }, claim_targets?: { name: both|id_token|access_token }, sign_in_outcome?: normal|access_denied|temporarily_unavailable|interaction_required|refresh_revoked (Pro) }
